chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a music box turns over once, alone, a soft rocking arpeggio in D minor, the mist pad breathing in underneath}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft pulse-wave lead singing a slow lullaby melody
thin low string pad like evening mist over a field
gentle triangle bass rocking root and fifth
a single glassy bell at the end of each phrase

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the lullaby melody: a gentle rising lift that reaches a little too high, then settles down toward home and stops just short of it on the fifth; slow, singable, rocking in three}

[Main Theme Reprise]
{the lullaby again, the music box now answering each phrase like a sleeper sighing, a faint bell at the end of the line}

[Bridge]
{contrast: up to B-flat major for a moment, the lead rests and the music box carries a warmer, almost hopeful phrase over the strings, like a memory of harvest, then it greys again toward D minor}
